alarms.action: Conveyor stops and a jam alarm is raised until reset
alarms.condition: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while the conveyor runs
alarms.name: Jam alarm

conflicts.narrative_says: Requires a 5.0 s jam detection timer when PE-1002 is blocked while the conveyor runs.
conflicts.program_says: T10 and the jam detection logic are completely missing from the ST10 program block.

steps.entry: Auto mode is active AND no ST10 fault is present
steps.exit: Auto mode is lost OR an ST10 fault becomes active
steps.name: Conveyor Run

steps.entry: Line controller requests a release (RQ-1005 rising edge)
steps.name: Stopper Release
